# Import files
```{r}
c = c( "Chlorophyll","logchla", "Date","Year", "Month",  "season","Regions","SAC","lagSAC",
       "EXPORT","OUT","lagOUT", "Index","lagIndex","DissAmmonia",
       "lagDissAmmonia", "TotPhos","lagTotPhos","DissNitrateNitrite", 
       "lagDissNitrateNitrite","Temperature","lagTemperature","Secchi", 
       "lagSecchi","Conductivity",  "lagConductivity","Biomass","Grazing_rate",
      "Filtration_rate","season_num")

df <- read.csv("Data/regional_integrated_dataset3.csv" )

df$Date = as.Date(df$Date)

#change Regions to factor for GAM to work as a random effect
df$Regions = as.factor(df$Regions)

#change season to numeric value for cyclic cubic spline?
df$season_num = as.numeric(as.factor(df$season))

df$logchla <- log(df$Chlorophyll)

df <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c)) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(c))
head(df)
```

#Bloom Absence/Presence

```{r}
# 1) Binary transformation of bloom absence/presence
bloom_thresholds <- df %>%
  group_by(Regions) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T),sd=sd(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T)) %>%
  mutate(bloom_thr = mean + sd) %>%
  select(-mean,-sd)

#mean/d group by region
#HABs vs BABs coming from different dataset
  
df <- df %>%
  merge(bloom_thresholds,by="Regions",all.x=T) %>%
  mutate(bloom = case_when(Chlorophyll > bloom_thr ~ 1,
                           .default = 0))

paste0("Number of blooms = ", sum(df$bloom))


```
# Other Transformations
```{r}
# Create dataframe with pre/post clam dummy variable
df <- df%>%mutate(clam_step=if_else(Year>1987, "post clam", "pre clam"))

```


# Model - Ryan's top models m4 and m6
```{r}

#Ryan's m4 - without export
bm1 <- gam(bloom~ DissAmmonia +
               DissNitrateNitrite +
               Temperature +
               Conductivity +
               SAC + 
               s(Regions, bs='re') +
               season +
               (SAC*season) +
            #replace grazing rate with clam step function
               clam_step +
               lagSAC +
               lagDissAmmonia +
               lagDissNitrateNitrite,
            family=binomial(link = "logit"),data=df)

#Ryan's m6 - with export
bm2 <- gam(bloom~ DissAmmonia +
               DissNitrateNitrite +
               Temperature +
               Conductivity +
               SAC + 
               EXPORT +
               s(Regions, bs='re') +
               season +
               (SAC*season) +
            #replace grazing rate with clam step function
               clam_step +
               lagSAC +
               lagDissAmmonia +
               lagDissNitrateNitrite,
            family=binomial(link = "logit"),data=df)

summary(bm1)
```
#AIC, BIC
## Compare with AIC
```{r}
AIC(bm1,bm2)
```

```{r}
BIC(bm1,bm2)
```


```{r}
options(na.action = "na.fail")
bm1.dredge <- dredge(bm1)
head(bm1, 3)
```
